propositions: Current CLI, library, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points resolve overlapping environment/files/cwd state independently without a single immutable configuration authority per operation.

An immutable, serializable OperationSnapshot must be composed once per operation with validated non-secret effective values, explicit source-kind provenance, selected repository root, and envelope version, then threaded through shared command seam, CLI, public library operations, MCP tools, and direct reconciler in shadow mode without altering execution or stored formats.

Composition precedence is explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default; repository root is selected from explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT environment > Git top-level/current directory.
Snapshot construction must reject secret wrappers and live capability/client objects; secret sentinels must be absent from serialization, fingerprinting, diagnostic output, schemas, and logs.

The temporary REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW switch is enabled by default, reads only at the composition boundary, and allows rollback to legacy behavior when set to canonical false without changing stored ticket/bridge formats.

Representative ordinary ticket/store, LLM-gate, and reconcile operations must produce identical snapshot values and fingerprints across CLI, Python, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points, with malformed config raising typed errors before lock/network/write effects.
